commenti.body: It's just a pretty boring film, not much else. I was expecting something spectacularly horrible stuff that would make me re-evaluate what it means to be human but just ended up waiting it until the the end. I don't get the outrage. It's a movie, for god's sake. Yes, some "disturbing" themes, but nothing you wouldn't have seen in a horror movie already.
I mean I’ve heard of a toddler rape scene. That’s something I haven’t seen.

I'm fine with the film. It wasn't as disturbing as I had thought. Let me quote my review on Letterboxd:

"A Serbian Film does not leave any negative impact on me as it did to most viewers. While some scenes are indeed grotesque beyond imagination, they don't leave me emotionally scarred. For me, a traumatic movie is the one that feels attached to brutal reality; that's not the case for A Serbian Film, where everything is exaggerated for metaphorical purpose. I can name at least 10 movies that are more visually and/or thematically repulsive (hello Kim Ki-duk, Lars Von Trier, Larry Clark etc).

In my honest opinion, the overwhelming disgust for this film is undeserved. The kinds of films that I despise the most are the ones which romanticize immorality, exploit sensitive topics for cheap entertainment, and manipulate viewers with forced melodrama. A Serbian Film committed none of those sins. On the other hand, although I respect the filmmaker's intentions and efforts, I believe there is another way to get the point across without upsetting the audience."

Yes, that's one of the disturbing scenes, for sure. But that's the only thing the movie really has to offer, some disturbing imagery. I still don't get the absolute outrage of it almost as if people think it's real. It's not real, it's a movie.

Maybe I'm too desensitized to movies, but as a movie it is just boring and bad as a whole.  Having some disturbing scenes doesn't change that.

It would be different if the movie itself was interesting and made you think stuff. Then also the disturbing scenes could actually function as a tool for the message. Now, there's really nothing else.
